worldcombat.skill.upperhand.summary: The moment the foe starts a priority move, step in and stop it with the heel of your palm; if the foe is not readying a priority move, the strike whiffs and its PP is still spent.
worldcombat.skill.upperhand.use.1: Punish enemies that steal the tempo with priority moves
worldcombat.skill.upperhand.use.2: Pin the foe back where it stood when it tried to go first
Land a %1$s-power palm strike; it only connects when the target committed a priority attack within the last %2$s, and it stops that move.
Palm reach %1$s blocks, %2$s blocks/tick, hit radius %3$s blocks; the target is shoved back %4$s blocks and left flinching %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.upperhand.wide.on: Wide sweep on: the palm carves a small fan that can stop several priority-movers at once, but each hit is -12%, the flinch is 6 ticks shorter, recovery +3 ticks and cooldown +5 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.upperhand.wide.off: Wide sweep off: a focused palm, heavier and with a longer flinch, but it can only stop one.
worldcombat.skill.upperhand.timing: Cast on an enemy within %1$s blocks; %2$s after starting it spends %4$s PP; recovery %3$s, cooldown %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.upperhand.growth.0: At level %1$s the palm rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.upperhand.growth.1: At level %1$s the palm rises to %2$s and the flinch lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.upperhand.preference.w: On: the palm carves a small fan that can stop several priority-movers at once, but each hit is -12%, the flinch is 6 ticks shorter, recovery +3 ticks and cooldown +5 ticks. Off: a focused palm, heavier and with a longer flinch.
worldcombat.skill.upperhand.preference.a: Only step in when the foe is this close; this move's reach is short, so a larger value often still cannot reach.
